description: event_type values of business events (spec F-35) written through the outbox to bank_logs. See contracts/schemas/event-payloads.schema.json for the payload contracts. Bank-originated events have channel SYSTEM and a null request_id.

event_types.request.completed: every API request of the public and generator listeners (not /healthz, /metrics or /internal/**), exactly one per HTTP arrival; payload: endpoint (route template or 'unmatched'), method, http_status, duration_ms, and where known request_type, replayed, attempt_id; money-moving completions also retain tran_amt, transfer_id, reason, counterparty_bank_code, counterparty_account_no
event_types.password_reset.requested: reset code issued, or a request for an unknown phone
event_types.password_reset.completed: password changed with a valid code
event_types.account.status_changed: account became dormant, active or closed
event_types.rollover.job_completed: a day-rollover job (maturity, dormancy, daily_close, atm_session_expiry) finished for a business date
event_types.atm.session_started: ATM session started; payload: terminal_id, region, latitude, longitude, account_no, request_id, session_id
event_types.atm.session_rejected: ATM session rejected; payload: terminal_id, region, latitude, longitude, account_no, request_id, bank_rsp_code, locked
event_types.atm.session_ended: ATM session ended; payload: terminal_id, region, latitude, longitude, account_no, request_id, reason, session_id, start_request_id, ended_at
event_types.atm.operation: ATM operation; payload: terminal_id, region, latitude, longitude, account_no, request_id, operation (withdraw, deposit, balance), outcome (approved, rejected), amount, rsp_code, bank_rsp_code
event_types.card.authorized: debit card payment authorized; payload: client_id, idempotency_key, card_no, krw_amount, amount, currency, merchant_name, mcc, country, entry_mode, latitude, longitude, decline_reason (null)
event_types.card.declined: debit card payment declined; same payload keys as card.authorized, with a non-null decline_reason
